ownerStatement: On 21 November 2026 repeat98 answered “Approve this scoped release” for FM Synth 0.1.5 after reviewing the measured MKII results and the open limits. The owner also reported speaking directly with Tim Hastie and receiving his OK for the idle-cost change.
reason: The tested USB package b904a852 on the MKII with the 0.7.13 development base averaged +0.619 percentage points on MWREPROB/TARGET. First-note wake, timing at 140 BPM, glide off and at 96, a saved FLEX marker and five Undos were observed. Worst-case chip cycles, complete memory bounds, cold-start persistence and sample-locked legacy notes on the unit remain open. TESTING.md documents the other untested playback cases. UI captures are retained from 0.1.2 because the release changes frame processing and keeps the same controls and pages.
